title: Trace Schema
$comment: metadata is persisted as-is by the backend (trace_metadata column; rename tracked by BE#665). correlation_ids is split into OTel columns and prompt_reference is materialized in the observability_prompt_links join table — structured platform data must use those dedicated top-level fields, never metadata sub-keys.

metadata.description: Opaque user-supplied annotations. Do NOT place structured platform data here — correlation_ids and prompt_reference are dedicated top-level fields, never sub-keys of metadata.

total_cost_usd.description: Total cost in USD; null when the cost is unknown (cost_status unpriced or partial). Never 0 for unknown.

priced_cost_usd.description: Priced portion of the cost only; a lower bound ("at least") when cost_status is partial or unpriced.

unpriced_observation_count.description: Number of observations without a price; emitted only when the server recorded a cost marker.

input_data.description: Raw user-supplied input payload for this trace (e.g. the prompt). Unconstrained JSON.

output_data.description: Raw model/agent output payload for this trace. Unconstrained JSON.
